# Build a set of downloaded song IDs and a dict of song details by ID
downloaded_by_id = {song['song_id']: song for song in downloaded}
downloaded_ids = set(downloaded_by_id.keys())

# For each album, check if all its songs are downloaded and compute total duration
candidates = []
for album in albums:
    song_ids = album['song_ids']
    all_downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_ids for sid in song_ids)
    if all_downloaded:
        total_duration = sum(downloaded_by_id[sid]['duration'] for sid in song_ids)
        if total_duration >= 900:  # 15 minutes = 900 seconds
            candidates.append((album, total_duration))

print("Candidates (album, total_duration_seconds):")
for album, dur in candidates:
    print(f"{album['title']} - {dur} sec")
